test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Melting a metal ball of radius 3 units, 26 identical dice and a ball of radius 1 units are made. What is the side of the dice?
solution:
**Given:**

Melting a metal ball of radius 3 units, 26 identical dice and a ball of radius 1 unit are made.

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

Volume of cube = a³

**Calculation:**

Volume of original ball = Volume of 1ball + volume of 26 cube

⇒ (4/3) π (3)³ = (4/3) π (1)3 + 26 × a³

⇒ (4/3) π (3)3 - (4/3) π (1)3 = 26 × a3

⇒ (4/3) π × 27 - (4/3) π × 1 = 26 × a3

⇒ (4/3) π (27 - 1) = 26 × a3

⇒ (4/3) π × 26 = 26 × a3

⇒ (4/3) π = a³

⇒ a3 = 4/3 × 22/7 = 88/21 = 4.19

⇒ a = ³√ 4.19 ≈ 1.6 units

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
